convo.recruitment.admire.say.1.neutral: All right. I can see the sense in following someone who has earned my trust.
convo.recruitment.admire.say.2.neutral: I was hoping you would ask. Give me a place in your group and I will pull my weight.
convo.recruitment.admire.say.3.neutral: Yes. I respect what you are building, and I would rather help than stand outside it.
convo.recruitment.fear.say.1.neutral: I do not like being cornered, but I know when I am outmatched. I will come with you.
convo.recruitment.fear.say.2.neutral: Fine. I will follow for now. Keep your word and we will not have a problem.
convo.recruitment.fear.say.3.neutral: You have made your point. I will join, but do not mistake caution for friendship yet.
We already had this conversation today. Give me time to think before you press me again.
Not again today. Let us see how things stand tomorrow.
convo.recruitment.reject.general.say.1.n: I cannot make that decision right now. There is too much working against it.
convo.recruitment.reject.general.say.2.n: No. I appreciate the offer, but joining you is not possible at the moment.
convo.recruitment.reject.general.say.3.n: I need to sort out a few things before I can even consider leaving with you.
convo.recruitment.reject.hostile.say.1.n: You want me to join you? Keep your distance.
convo.recruitment.reject.hostile.say.2.n: I am not joining you. Do not mistake this conversation for trust.
convo.recruitment.reject.leader.say.1.ne: I already have people depending on me. I cannot walk away from them for your group.
convo.recruitment.reject.leader.say.2.ne: I am responsible for this shelter. Until that changes, I am staying here.
convo.recruitment.reject.member.say.1.ne: You are already with us. Ask me about orders instead of recruiting me again.
convo.recruitment.reject.member.say.2.ne: I am already part of this group.
convo.recruitment.reject.relationship.sa: I am not ready to put my life in your hands. We need more time before you ask that again.
Let's keep talking and see how we manage before making any commitments.
You seem capable, but I do not know you well enough to join your group.
That is a serious promise. We have not built enough trust for me to make it.
Out here, joining up takes real trust. We aren't there yet.
I'm not looking to tie myself to people I barely know.
We haven't been through enough together for me to make that call.
Give it time. Asking someone to join your group isn't a small thing.
I appreciate the thought, but I need to see how you operate first.
I'm surviving on my own for now until I'm certain about who has my back.
convo.recruitment.reject.unavailable.say: I cannot make that decision while I am unavailable.
This is not a conversation I can have right now.
